decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already fully records the rendering-fidelity decision for the machine and separate base; no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The general aesthetic-fidelity instruction does not necessarily alter the existing explicit display name, placard placement, wording, or logo details.
Decorative LED lighting and its rendering-inspired purpose were already established; the source adds no specific lighting change.
The source contains no specific color change and does not necessarily override the established beige-and-green scheme.
Aesthetic fidelity to the renderings does not necessarily change the established bowl capacity or deep-well form.
The spout already has explicit rendering-based appearance and geometry requirements, and the source adds no new spout-specific state.
The aesthetic instruction does not change the task-local system-layout or CAD deliverable.
The source does not select components, revise the BOM, or necessarily require additional component changes.
Recreating the exterior aesthetics does not change the whisk's size, material, attachment, positioning, or cleaning configuration.
The aesthetic decision does not alter the required mixing quality, foam consistency, or high-speed behavior.
The source does not modify the splash-control target or its mitigation options.
Aesthetic fidelity does not necessarily change the existing policy of using off-the-shelf components where practical while allowing required custom fabrication.
